ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.25:0.75 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear streaks are distributed across both lobes, primarily in the medial and distal regions. A concentrated patch of white mottling is located in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe. Contiguous black pigmentation occupies the majority of the lower regions and the central notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central notch with an estimated vertex angle of 50 degrees and a depth relative to lobe height of approximately 1:5.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary along the entire trailing edge, characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude (2-8 pixel) peaks and valleys, distinct from the water interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a sharp convex sweep; trailing edges exhibit a generally linear trajectory with localized concavities near the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel rosettes (barnacles) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the ventral surface, most prominent on the left lobe and upper section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive healed rake mark scarring across both lobes and significant barnacle colonization on the distal lobe extremities.
